stage: Re-entry from orbit: capsules, robot pod and orbital strikes
status: Built and checked locally; author playtest pending; not deployed
machine: Author's Windows workstation, Chrome 155.0.8059.86, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti

frameCost.method: Sustained barrage (31 shells over 15 s), 1920x1080, measured 9-17 s after the order with Chrome CPU throttling at 10x as a proxy for a slow device. The comparison serves a copy of reentry-art.js whose smoke and plasma drawing return immediately; everything else is identical.
frameCost.throttle4: Both the full run and the earlier reduced-effects comparison held the 144 Hz display rate
frameCost.reading: About 3.8 ms per frame at 10x throttle, roughly 0.4 ms unthrottled on this machine, in the worst case measured. Before trimming gradient stops and samples and adding off-screen culling it was about 6.3 ms at 10x. Not measured on phones or low-end hardware.

fixtures: Disposable worlds in temporary DATA_DIRs via the legacy route; no developer save was opened, changed or reset.
